label: Text 1
transcript: Klasse 12 returns to post-colonial writing with a longer reach: an extract from Salman Rushdie's East / West (1994), one from Tsitsi Dangarembga's Nervous Conditions (1988), and one from Arundhati Roy's non-fiction The Algebra of Infinite Justice (2002). The class spent the lesson learning to read hybridity not as celebration but as a working condition.
